conbody.p: Using Mark Fields, you can mark small chunks of the agreement document content as fields. When you mark content in an agreement document as a field, it becomes a smart field. Smart field values can be reconciled with data in the agreement record when the document is checked in, allowing changes made during negotiation to be accurately reflected and managed as data in the Conga CLM. Content marked as a field must map to the data type of existing fields in your agreement record.

note.p: Marking a field in a single agreement does not mark the field across all other documents for the same agreement record.
